title: Keep a compact local-source representation from silently becoming a generic finite-density method
statement: For a uniform extensive quench, the rotated source gives exact grade q~Binomial(L,sin²(epsilon t)). At fixed nonzero time away from multiples of pi and fixed K, retained probability tends to zero for0<p<1; at p1 it is zero forK<L. The source itself is a trivial solvable global rotation. Generic finite-density inputs also need not rotate to a low-grade seed.

body: The eta-coherent input or its qualified phase-averaged ensemble is special and physically unacquired; generic thermal/fixed-density states and extensive perturbations do not inherit the low-grade representation. This does not improve the earlier extreme weak-coupling resonant construction. Ordinary symmetry-aware nonlinear particle-sector truncation is the same engine, so a nonlinear/linear difference is not an algorithmic advantage.
